title: Banner, backdrops & flags · Overview
slide_intent: Match event identification to the available surface and the number of partners. A flag, a tall sign and a sponsored backdrop each give the audience a different amount of information to read.
strategic_value: The same mark and curve can connect local event formats while preserving distinct space for athletes, sponsors or an event identity.
demonstration: Seven numbered groups compare horizontal and vertical banners, an athlete photograph, a flag, sponsor configurations and an event banner. The flag note identifies the need to align the two faces.
practical_value: Choose a format before assigning logo and sponsor space. Use the single-partner and multi-partner examples to decide how many identifiers one surface can hold.
